notes: Transcribed from the backend app's LogsBatchController, verified 2026-08-19.
There is no allow-list here: a key outside `fields` is dropped by the validator rather than rejecting the item. Both SDKs still send exactly the six keys in `fields`.

`context` and `extra` are free-shape arrays at ingest. Anything the SDKs agree to put inside them is a convention between the SDKs, not a rule the server enforces, which is why it lives in `extra_vocabulary` rather than in `fields`.
Both SDKs may replace an oversized `context` or `extra` wholesale with a single `_truncated` key carrying the reason. That is legal here precisely because these fields are free-shape.

extra_vocabulary.note: The keys the SDKs attach to `extra` on top of whatever the host logged. The canonical source is RanetraceHandler::extra() in ranetrace/ranetrace-php. The Laravel SDK reports the same vocabulary since it moved to the shared log builder; its old `laravel_version` key is retired.

framework.note: Absent rather than null when the host said nothing, so absence reads as "not said" instead of "no framework".

framework_version.note: Absent rather than null when the host said nothing.
